title: Senior or Lead Compliance Analyst
description:
Job Description:

Overview
Deriva Energy is a leading Independent Power Producer in the US renewables market, with over 6.5 GW of operating or under construction wind, solar and storage projects across the country. Formerly a part of Duke Energy, Deriva is now a Brookfield Renewable company. Brookfield Renewable operates one of the world’s largest publicly traded, pure-play renewable power platforms. Join a dynamic team committed to excellence and innovation who envision a future of energy independence using resilient, carbon-free generation. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to make a significant impact in the rapidly evolving energy industry.  Deriva empowers customers with innovative clean energy solutions that strengthen communities and serve future generations.

Position Summary
The Compliance Analyst supports Deriva Energy’s efforts to maintain compliance with applicable NERC Operations and Planning (O&P) Standards. This role works closely with the Generation Compliance team and internal Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to help review documentation, maintain compliance records, and support ongoing monitoring of compliance activities.
The Compliance Analyst will assist with evidence collection, documentation updates, and audit preparation while gaining familiarity with NERC requirements and internal compliance processes. This position may also support small compliance-related projects and process improvement initiatives.

This position is located at Deriva Energy Headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

Main Responsibilities

- Develop a working knowledge of NERC Operations and Planning (O&P) Standards and their application to Deriva Energy’s operations

- Support NERC compliance activities across Deriva Energy’s projects and operational processes

- Assist in reviewing compliance documentation and evidence with guidance from compliance team members and SMEs

- Help prepare documentation and coordinate materials needed for NERC compliance audits or internal reviews

- Track compliance activities and help maintain organized compliance records and documentation

- Support the development and maintenance of compliance procedures, policies, and internal controls

- Assist with monitoring and reporting on the status of NERC O&P compliance activities

- Help communicate compliance updates and requirements to internal stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner

- Support compliance training initiatives, including preparing materials and coordinating sessions

- Collaborate with internal teams, including IT, to support tools and systems used for compliance tracking and reporting

- Participate in addressing compliance questions and requests from internal teams

- Stay informed on NERC compliance updates through training, industry resources, and team collaboration

- Provide support for regulatory data requests and reporting related to NERC O&P compliance

- Assist with small compliance-related projects and process improvement initiatives as assigned

Senior Level Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field

- Three (3) years or more work experience in a relevant field

- In lieu of bachelor's degree, high school diploma/GED AND five (5) years or more years of related work experience

Lead Level Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field

- Five (5) years or more work experience in a relevant field

- In lieu of bachelor's degree, high school diploma/GED AND seven (7) years or more years of related work experience

Desired Qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering or related field

- Five (5) years or more work experience in a relevant field, coupled with a deep understanding of NERC compliance

- Exceptional project management and multitasking abilities

- Prior experience with generation related to NERC Compliance Operations and Planning Standards

- Demonstrated aptitude for fostering a culture of compliance within teams

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint

- Experience applying risk management frameworks is a plus

Working Conditions

- This position is based in Charlotte, NC

- This is an in-person position with option to work remotely one day per week

Benefits

- Health Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- 401(k) with matching

- Employee assistance program

- Flexible spending account

- Life insurance

- Paid time off

- Parental leave

- Attractive Bonus Potential

Additional Information:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Deriva welcomes veterans of the United States Armed Forces to apply for this position. Deriva includes veterans of all branches and a diverse set of occupational specialties. We value the independent thinking, problem solving, leadership, and teamwork that our veterans have developed through their service. We welcome applications from any service and any military occupational specialty.

Deriva Energy is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Director, Origination
description:
Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY

As Director of Origination, this role is responsible for originating new business across defined U.S. regions — developing customer relationships, communicating Deriva's story and product offerings, and structuring transactions across the company's operational and development portfolio. This role drives execution of origination activities, ensures profitability and growth, and manages commercial transaction risk. This role works closely with the Head of Origination and leads cross-functional deal teams through the full transaction lifecycle, from bid through close.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Origination Strategy & Deal Execution

- Lead execution of origination strategy aligned with Deriva's business objectives, within an assigned market or customer segment

- Originate, structure, and negotiate PPAs and related offtake agreements with utility, C&I, and large-load counterparties

- Secure long-term agreements with utilities and corporations to support financing and buildout of new renewable and storage projects

- Develop PPA restructuring, blend-and-extend, and other structured product solutions to improve existing asset economics, including bilateral deal structures

- Evaluate RFPs, lead bid strategy, and lead internal stakeholders (EPC, analytics, legal, development, finance) through bid preparation, competitive analysis, and procurement

- Prepare approval materials, in tandem with the Head of Origination, outlining commercial strategy and key risks for bids, term sheets, and definitive agreements

- Maintain an up-to-date deal pipeline and organized bid/transaction documentation

Customer, Market & Portfolio Development

- Provide commercial input to inform greenfield development siting strategy and evaluate origination opportunities for prospective M&A targets

- Support merchant-exposure planning as legacy PPAs expire, evaluating market timing, pricing, tenor, and risk allocation

- Prepare proposals and presentation materials for customers and buyers

- Monitor RTO market and regulatory developments and translate them into actionable deal strategy

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with utilities, C&I customers, power trading firms, and market peers

WORKING CONDITIONS

- This is an in-office position located in our corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.; remote may be considered for a highly qualified and well-networked candidate.

- Relocation assistance to Charlotte, NC is available.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree required

- Eight (8) or more years of experience in the energy industry

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus

- 10 or more years of experience in the energy industry, including a minimum of five (5) years in power origination

- Demonstrated success securing long-term power sale agreements with utilities and corporations in the clean energy sector

- Demonstrated ability to lead, structure, negotiate, and execute power sale agreements with internal and external advisors

- Working knowledge of RTO operations, transmission, and generation/storage technologies in WECC, SPP, and ERCOT, or MISO and PJM

- Strong understanding of power market regulatory frameworks, dynamics, and pricing mechanisms

- Strong sales, negotiation, leadership, and time-management skills, with the ability to motivate cross-functional deal teams

- Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to assess risk and market data to inform decisions

- Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple concurrent deals in a fast-paced environment

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with sound judgment and integrity in prior roles

Benefits

- Health Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- 401(k) with matching

- Short Term Incentive Bonus

- Employee assistance program

- Flexible spending account

- Life insurance

- Paid time off

- Parental leave

Additional Information:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Deriva welcomes veterans of the United States Armed Forces to apply for this position. Deriva includes veterans of all branches and a diverse set of occupational specialties. We value the independent thinking, problem solving, leadership, and teamwork that our veterans have developed through their service. We welcome applications from any service and any military occupational specialty.
